Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973: S. 319-Summoning of other persons as accused-Appellant along with others arrayed as accused-Proceedings against him quashed u/s. 482-Afler conclusion of prosecution evidence State filing application u!s. 319 for summoning the appellant-Trial court rejecting the appellant-Held, for exercise of discretion all relevant factors have to be kept in view and an order is not required to be made mechanically merely on the ground that some evidence has come on record implicating the person sought to be added as an accused-,-On facts, exercise of discretion by
